questions.skill: Describe a sequence of rigid motions that shows two figures are congruent
questions.prompt: Figure P is mapped onto figure Q by a 90° rotation followed by a translation. Which statement is true?
questions.prompt_markup:

choices.text: P and Q are not congruent because they face different directions.
P and Q have different angle measures.

questions.skill: Describe a sequence of rigid motions that shows two figures are congruent
questions.prompt: Explain why a triangle and its image after a dilation with a scale factor of 2 are not congruent.
questions.prompt_markup: Explain why a triangle and its image after a dilation with a scale factor of 2 are not congruent.
questions.correct_answer: The dilation doubles every side length, but rigid motions (which show congruence) keep lengths the same.
